title: Ruchit Jain of Motilal Oswal suggests AXIS Bank, Genus Power shares to buy for the short term
summary: Indian equity benchmarks surged today, driven by falling crude oil prices and supportive comments from the RBI Governor. The Nifty 50 rose 0.95%, while the BSE Sensex gained 1.27%.
